2609.24453.title: Predicting Postprandial Glycemic Response from Meal Images, Clinical Variables, and Gut Microbiome Information
2609.24453.paper_summary: Predicting postprandial glycemic response (PPGR) is fundamental to personalized nutrition and type 2 diabetes management, yet existing approaches typically rely on manually reported dietary intake, limiting their scalability in free-living settings. We propose a multimodal framework that replaces manual dietary logging with image-derived macronutrient estimates and integrates them with clinical variables and gut microbiome information for personalized PPGR prediction. The framework jointly performs image-based macronutrient estimation and glucose prediction, while an attention-based prediction module models interactions between dietary and host-specific information. We evaluate the proposed approach on a real-world dataset comprising meal images, continuous glucose monitoring, clinical variables, and gut microbiome profiles. The proposed model outperforms existing PPGR baselines using image-derived nutritional inputs and approaches the performance of methods that rely on manually reported macronutrients despite using automatically estimated nutritional information. These results demonstrate that combining image-derived nutrition with complementary clinical and gut microbiome information provides a practical foundation for scalable personalized PPGR prediction.
2609.24453.paper_summary_zh: 預測餐後血糖反應（PPGR）對於個性化營養和2型糖尿病管理至關重要，然而現有的方法通常依賴手動報告的飲食攝入，限制了其在自由生活環境中的可擴展性。<lb/>我們提出了一個多模態框架，將手動飲食記錄替換為基於圖像的宏量營養素估計，並將其與臨床變量和腸道微生物組信息整合，以實現個性化的PPGR預測。<lb/>該框架共同執行基於圖像的宏量營養素估計和葡萄糖預測，同時基於注意力的預測模塊建模飲食和宿主特定信息之間的互動。<lb/>我們在一個包含餐點圖像、連續血糖監測、臨床變量和腸道微生物組特徵的真實世界數據集上評估了所提出的方法。<lb/>所提出的模型在使用基於圖像的營養輸入時超越了現有的PPGR基準，並且在性能上接近依賴手動報告的宏量營養素的方法，儘管使用的是自動估計的營養信息。<lb/>這些結果表明，將基於圖像的營養與互補的臨床和腸道微生物組信息相結合，為可擴展的個性化PPGR預測提供了一個實用的基礎。
